$comment: Coverage gate for CI and pre-push. Enforced on internal/controller (unit-tested package). Ratcheted to current honest %; raise toward 100 as coverage grows. e2e, generated DeepCopy, and thin cmd/api wiring are exempt.

enforcement.description: CI and pre-push MUST fail when internal/controller statement coverage falls below thresholds.statements. Prefer make test (writes cover.out with envtest assets). Raise the ratchet when coverage improves; do not lower it without documenting why.

exemptions.notes: Generated DeepCopy/zz_generated code, e2e packages, api/v1alpha1 type-only packages, and thin main/cmd wiring are excluded from the denominator. Worker bash is covered by bats/shellcheck (nominatim-5et.26), not go cover.
